title: Groups extend it-ops-kb from their own repository through a versioned extension API
goal: kbsettings reads the defaults, group, clone, kb root and user layers with group locks; kbext.py loads a group's extender by point from the settings layers or an entry point and refuses a missing or mismatched one by name; backlog.json keys take overrides from the settings layers; the lane, forge, ranker, mcp_tools, ingest_mappers, gate_checks, leak_scan and backlog_commands points take a group's extender; kbext.py surface, lint, verify and kbgit.py ext-release keep the extension API versioned; kbext.py init-team writes a group overlay repository; and kbext.py rehearse takes a planted fork and overlay from one ext tag to the next with no conflict
